paragraphs.text: The City in a Bottle was an artifact in El-Hajjâj 's workshop at his castle . It was guarded by a Guardian Beast . As the name implies, it contained a miniature city within a bottle, and was used to hold the Baby Taysir .
The city was inspired by the comic book story The Sandman #50, "Ramadan," by Neil Gaiman , which was a significant inspiration to Richard Garfield in creating Arabian Nights .
